technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but strong downtrend structure and bearish moving average alignment limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: GE shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 41 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales 6+ months old) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5), flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and negative macro score (-5) create severely adverse conditions; GE earnings in 41 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic RSI, Williams %R) with contrarian fear sentiment (11/100) and early reversal signals (StochRSI cross-up) create textbook bounce setup at support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis 383.5, FOMC today, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), complete absence of bullish structure (price below all MAs, MACD bearish, death cross active, Ichimoku below cloud), zero fundamental conviction, and 41-day earnings event risk overwhelm oversold technicals.
